dedupe_keys.name: sandi 2024 substation network traffic for training intrusion detection iec 61850 and iec 60870 5 104

description: SANDI-2024, Substation Anomaly Network Data for Intrusion detection, is a set of network captures from electrical substations for training and testing machine-learning intrusion detectors, published on Zenodo with a Data in Brief article by Gutiérrez Mlot, Saldana, Rodríguez, Kotsiuba and Hernández Gañán. Attack-free traffic was captured with tcpdump over seven days at two real substations, in Iltsi, Ukraine, and Granada, Spain, and attack traces were generated on laboratory testbeds in Zaragoza. Files cover IEC 61850 traffic, including PTP and a normal fault case, with flooding, fuzzing, replay and PTP attacks, and IEC 60870-5-104 traffic with denial of service, flooding, fuzzing, starvation, man-in-the-middle, NTP amplification and port scan attacks; each is given as raw PCAP and as processed CSV features, with scripts in a GitHub repository. Coverage is two substations and lab testbeds. Files are free under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which rules out commercial use. Caveats: captures were anonymised and filtered, attack traffic is synthetic, and one week of normal traffic limits seasonal behaviour. Simulation uses are cyber attack scenarios on substation automation and protection traffic for cyber-physical resilience and digital twin testing. Related records: data-xai4heat-district-heating-scada-nis covers SCADA process data for heat.
